review.notes: Checked against full judgment, no changes. extension_notification_validity correctly not_decided/contested=true/quote_source=argument: the judgment itself documents conflicting HC views (Allahabad, Patna, Guwahati, Telangana) and a pending Supreme Court SLP (4240/2025), and expressly leaves the issue open pending that outcome (para 15) -- no court ruling exists yet to quote. reply_not_considered/defect_rejected directly supported at para 10 (quoted order excerpt shows the reply was considered and rejected on merits, not ignored). No hearing defect since a hearing was in fact afforded and attended (para 9). Outcome disposed/not remanded matches para 11-17 (writ declined, extended appeal window granted instead).
